concept_en: The Risks of Early Queen Development
question_cn: 开局过早把后出动（如第2步就出后）的主要风险是什么？
question_en: What is the main risk of bringing the queen out too early, such as on move two?

options.text_cn: 后太强，出来之后对手会立刻认输
options.text_en: The queen is so powerful that the opponent will immediately resign.

options.text_cn: 后会被对方的马和象攻击，被迫不断逃跑，每跑一步就浪费一步先手，对方反而加速发展
options.text_en: The opponent can attack the queen with knights and bishops, forcing it to retreat while developing their own pieces.

options.text_cn: 后出来后会堵住己方其他棋子的出路
options.text_en: The queen blocks the development of your other pieces.

options.text_cn: 后出来之后无法再退回，容易被将军
options.text_en: Once developed, the queen cannot retreat and is easily checked.

explanation_cn: 后是最强的棋子，但在开局时对方的马和象可以在正常发展的同时攻击后，迫使后不断撤退。每次后逃跑就等于浪费一步，对方的马和象趁机出动，发展领先。「每被追一次就是失去先手」——帕勒姆进攻就是利用这个原理。开局应先出轻子，后在大部分子力就位后再出动。
explanation_en: The queen is powerful, but the opponent can develop knights and bishops while attacking it, forcing it to retreat. Each retreat costs a tempo while the opponent develops. The Wayward Queen Attack illustrates this idea: every queen chase can help the opponent gain time. Develop minor pieces first and bring out the queen after most of your army is ready.
